report.summary: L-1, L-2 and L-4 already have adequate existing coverage from the builder's change (test_collector_equivalence.py's FilesRelativeToTheRepository, and the unchanged 304 pre-existing local tests). One genuine gap found and filled for L-3: no test drove validate() against an actual run document to prove a findings entry missing a required key is rejected -- coverage rested only on the hand-typed SHAPES literal pin and the generic list_of mechanism exercised via the unrelated catalogue kind. Added one case to local/tests/test_records.py (Nested class). local/tests: 306 passed / 0 failed (baseline 305 + 1 new). Nothing staged, committed or pushed; only local/tests/test_records.py edited.
